text: Active sparking and crackling sound coming from main circuit breaker box in hallway. Strong burning plastic smell. Tenant isolated main switch.
Single toilet blocked and raw sewage backing up into bathroom shower recess. House has elderly resident and two young children with no second bathroom.
External front wooden entry steps rotted out completely. Lower tread snapped underfoot, leaving a steep drop-off and blocking safe egress.
Hairline fissure across external bedroom window pane. Tenant secured it with packing tape from inside. Glass is intact, no drafts or rattles.
Laundry trough cold tap has persistent slow drip from base of spout when turned off. Roughly one bucket filled every 12 hours.
Main split-system air conditioner stopped blowing cool air and leaks water down the living room plasterboard wall whenever switched on.
Intermittent electrical buzzing inside wall cavity behind refrigerator. Breaker has not tripped yet, but sound worsens when compressor kicks in.
Concealed water leak under concrete slab. Water meter spinning continuously with all fixtures closed, and soil beside foundation is waterlogged.
Subterranean termites detected entering through base of skirting board in back bedroom. Plasterboard feels soft when pressed.
Ceiling plasterboard in hallway sagging noticeably after heavy rainfall event. No active water drip currently, but ceiling bows down ~50mm.
Aesthetic issue: cosmetic paint flaking and dry water stains on ceiling from a roof leak that was repaired last dry season.
External security screen mesh torn near handle latch. Lock mechanism still operates, but flies and insects enter freely.
